card.name: The letter V inside abbreviations and names
card.fires_on: The letter v or V (or a closing piece of a name) partway through an abbreviation, URL or proper name, such as W/V, WV, BWV, AMVUTTRA or Warfield.

modes.label: V in abbreviations
modes.description: A capital or lowercase V inside a short code, such as weight-per-volume (w/v), WV or BWV.

modes.label: Inside proper names
modes.description: A piece in the middle or at the end of a person's or place name, as in William Warfield or Wordsworth.
modes.example: the distinguished American baritone, William War<<field>> as narrator

modes.label: V in a brand name
modes.description: The V in a drug brand name or web address.

card.plain: It fires on the letter V or a name ending when it sits inside an abbreviation or name, like w/v or WV.
